name: rsi_oversold_p21_t35
thesis: A looser, slower RSI to catch the shallow, short-lived dips that happen inside a steady low-vol uptrend, since deep oversold conditions are unlikely to show up right now.

name: low_52w_bounce_loose
thesis: A looser band than the two incumbent 52-week-low strategies, to test whether casting a wider net for laggards still works when the broad market is grinding higher.

name: low_52w_bounce_mid
thesis: A middle-ground proximity-to-low band between the two incumbents (1.015 tight / 1.08 loose) to triangulate whether the sweet spot is somewhere in between.

name: three_red_days_quick
thesis: A quick mean-reversion bounce after three consecutive down days, sized for a fast exit since pullbacks inside this uptrend have tended to resolve quickly.
